notes.title: Bugfix
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Closing the menu on game over will now properly start the next game.
[*]The countdown counts to 1 again, before ending the game.
[*]Fruits can not be dropped on top of the angled wall anymore.
[*]The slider value in the controls menu is now being saved and loaded on game start/end.
[/list]

tags.bug: -Closing the menu on game over will now properly start the next game.
-The countdown counts to 1 again, before ending the game.
-Fruits can not be dropped on top of the angled wall anymore.
-The slider value in the controls menu is now being saved and loaded on game start/end.

notes.title: Leaderboard
notes.content:
Changed the size of the leaderboard to a maximum of 1100.
You will see 1000 entries around yourself + the top 100.

Also added more font support, now most of your weird names should be visible in the leaderboard.
